# Ecclesiastes Chapter 11 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Ecclesiastes Chapter 11 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 11:1 — "bread upon the waters"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Send your-bread upon the-face of-the-waters" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "Cast your bread upon the waters" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "Send your grain across the seas" | Interprets as maritime trade |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS — preserves ambiguity of the original.

---

## 11:5 — "wind/spirit" and "bones/body"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-way of-the-wind... like-bones in-the-womb" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "the way the spirit comes to the bones" | "Spirit" reading |
| PNEUMA | "the path of the wind or the mystery of a baby" | Two separate images |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "wind" (connection to v.4) and "body" (more accessible than "bones").

**Status:** All resolved.
